E0501

Empty `[]` needs a context type

What

Empty `[]` needs a context type

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Give the empty list a context type.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0501: tests/ui/empty_list.stderr.

Error [E0501]: An empty list needs a type
  --> tests/ui/empty_list.jet:2:11
    |
  2 |     xs :: []
    |           ^^
 Why: Write `[]` only where the list type is already known from around it
 Fix: Name the element type on the literal: `[Int].{}`
